title: Let Them Fight
plainText:
--- title: Let Them Fight type: exercise order: 2 --- ## Exercise 1: Compare Different LLM Models (15 mins) - Discuss with two generative AI models at the same time, use arena.ai in **battle mode** — two AIs answer the same prompt, you vote for the better response. - Indicate after each round which one is better - If one "wins" a round, it's answers will be used as context for the follow-up questions for *both* bodels - Be aware that they will be *very* confident in their approaches. Make sure to understand and judge every aspect of the discussion.

Round 1 — "Easy"

I plan to wash my car. The car wash is 50m away. Should I take the car or go by foot?

Round 2 — "Complex"

I have 10GB of spectral measurement data I'd like to analyze. Which programming language should I use, and why?

This is intentionally incomplete — iterate, add constraints, push for a concrete architecture.

Reflection — What are the AIs doing well? Where do they struggle?
